OpenCode Mobile controls sessions on an opencode server running on your development machine.
OpenCode Mobile is a native client for opencode sessions — work in progress. It is not an official OpenCode product.
Point the app at an opencode server on your machine. We recommend Tailscale so your phone can reach it securely from anywhere.

The app talks to an opencode server you run. Short path below — full detail in the official docs.
Start the server on your machine
In your project, run the opencode server (headless). Keep it running while you use the phone.
Set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD. Username defaults to opencode unless you set OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME.

Recommended: Tailscale — install Tailscale on the machine and phone, then use the machine’s Tailscale IP or MagicDNS name as the server URL.\n\nAlso fine: same LAN, VPN, HTTPS, or another tunnel you manage. The app does not create a relay for you.
Enter base URL + password. The app checks GET /global/health, then saves a Connection Profile on this device.
This device forgets the Connection Profile. Sessions stay on that server. If it’s the active server, you’ll pick another — or land on Connect if none remain.
